prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: production PBR bark albedo source, one square 2048 x 2048 image, maximum native detail.
Paint a single continuous flat orthographic patch of living strangler fig / banyan bark, representing 1.6 metres horizontally and 2.0 metres vertically. This is smooth tropical fig skin over soft shallow vertical folds, NOT fissured oak, NOT birch, NOT concrete, NOT an isolated trunk. Fill every pixel with bark. The surface runs vertically. No trunk silhouettes, scenery, leaves, roots sticking out, borders, text, shadows or lighting gradients.
The skin has broad irregular softly interlocking weathering patches 20–80 cm across: warm muted cream-grey high areas, cooler older grey areas, sparse olive grey-green algae stains. Midtone overall is approximately sRGB (150,150,138). The palest areas only (190,185,165), old cool grey (110,119,112), sparse algae (89,99,74), and a few narrow faded vertical damp stains near (95,98,85), 2–4 cm across, irregular lengths up to 1 m. No dramatic black grooves. Living tactile supple wood, smooth but not featureless, not chalky.
Fine surface anatomy: hundreds of delicate mostly horizontal uneven lenticel dashes and broken shallow skin wrinkles, arranged organically around the vertical grain. Several subtle locally bunched curved transverse creases where tissue bends, not all-over horizontal stripes. Sparse tiny grey-white crustose lichen rosettes, irregular lobed colonies 2–6 cm wide, in loose varied clusters, low contrast, never bright white. A few tiny healed oval scars, quiet and irregular, no large knots. Finely layered natural microtexture with smooth open breathing areas between marks; no pepper noise.
Restrained vertical muscular flow but NO deep root separations and NO wooden planks. Broad variation must be legible when viewed small, while all the details remain subdued. Avoid a uniform light surface. Realistic hand-authored AAA botanical material quality. Perfectly even diffuse unlit pigment, no directional highlight, no ambient occlusion burned in, no specular. Seamlessly tileable on both axes with matching edge character. The entire image is one unique nonrepeating composition, no internal duplication, no grid or symmetry.
